work_assignment: Each core owns a fixed contiguous quarter of the tiles on every pass.
source_coordinates: For tile t, h=t%16 and g=t//16. Use head h, rows starting at 4*((4*g+h)%64), columns starting at 4*((g+3*h)%64).
metric: Wall interval on core 0 across dispatch and join, divided by all timed scores on four cores. Each process warms the same tile kernel on all four cores before measurement. UART wall includes startup, input loading and the untimed warm pass. Timing is throughput.
selection_rule: In each of both independently started batches the RVV median ns/score must be lower, with a paired majority of shorter runs and a positive median paired scalar-minus-RVV margin.
decision: Retain scalar. No integration into the complete Attention graph or rerun of the full model.
